description: This file defines the 'Article' class within the 'Conduit.Domain' namespace, representing an article entity in the domain model with properties for metadata, relationships (author, comments, tags, favorites), and computed attributes.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: A domain model class representing an article with metadata, author, comments, tags, and favorites.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Returns true if the article has any favorites.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Returns a list of tag identifiers associated with the article.
